Shammah_2: third-born (1 Chronicles 2:13) son of Jesse (1 Samuel 16:9) brother of David
Joab_1: son of Zeruiah (2 Samuel 2:13), commander of David's army (1 Chronicles 27:34)
Sibbecai_1: the Hushathite (2 Samuel 21:18) of the Zerahites
Saph_1: among the descendants of Raphah ["the giant"?] (2 Samuel 21:18)
Elhanan_1: son of Jaare-oregim (2 Samuel 21:19), seventh of "the thirty" of David's men (2 Samuel 23:24)
Jonathan_4: son of Shimei, David's brother (2 Samuel 21:21)
Lahmi_1: the brother of Goliath the Gittite (1 Chronicles 20:5)
